metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-4. - Trains blocking streets.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person or corporation to block or permit the blocking
               of any street within the city by a train for a period in excess of five minutes.
(
Ord. No. 4098, § 2, 11-19-2007
)
